scope: All country_flags media in the actual Catalog Web bundle, with complete standalone image/audio/video file coverage and linkage to the existing original icon inventory; runtime fonts are audited separately.

upstream_artwork.provenance_policy: The distributable SI bytes are fixed by country_flags 4.1.2 pub archive SHA-256 and individual file hashes. The recorded flag-icons commit pins the official license only; recreating the upstream conversion is not a release condition.
